title: EasyGoldEco
description: This plugin is an easy economy for your server. You can sell gold for money and pay other people to make trades.
body:
EasyGoldEco is a lightweight economy plugin.

Features:
- /balance – check your money
- /sellgold – sell gold for money
- /pay <player> <amount> – send money to other players

Works on Spigot/Paper Bukkit 1.21.11
